def factor_volume_adjusted_price_range_regime_smoothed(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    high_low = df_copy['high'] - df_copy['low']
    volume_ema = df_copy['volume'].ewm(span=20, adjust=False).mean().replace(0, np.nan)
    volume_ratio = df_copy['volume'] / volume_ema
    volume_ratio = volume_ratio.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    raw_signal = high_low * volume_ratio
    smoothed_signal = raw_signal.ewm(span=10, adjust=False).mean()
    if 'style_gate_resvol_high' in df_copy.columns:
        resvol_high = df_copy['style_gate_resvol_high']
        factor = np.where(resvol_high > 0, smoothed_signal * 1.2, smoothed_signal * 0.8)
    else:
        factor = smoothed_signal
    df_copy["factor_volume_adjusted_price_range_regime_smoothed"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_volume_adjusted_price_range_regime_smoothed"]
